0.en: At ten to six, Jack was sitting on the living room floor with a crib in pieces around him and a screwdriver in his teeth.
0.id: Pukul enam kurang sepuluh, Jack duduk di lantai ruang tengah dengan potongan-potongan boks bayi di sekelilingnya dan obeng di antara giginya.

1.en: It had been leaning against the hall closet in its flat cardboard box since the week before the activation. Nobody had touched it. That morning he couldn't sleep, couldn't sit still, and couldn't do anything useful with one hand. So he had dragged it out and opened it before he could think too hard about why.
1.id: Boks itu sudah bersandar di lemari lorong dalam kotak kardusnya yang pipih sejak seminggu sebelum aktivasi. Tak ada yang menyentuhnya. Pagi itu Jack tidak bisa tidur, tidak bisa duduk diam, dan tidak bisa melakukan apa pun yang berguna dengan satu tangan. Jadi ia menyeretnya keluar dan membukanya sebelum sempat berpikir terlalu keras tentang alasannya.

2.en: Sarah lay on the couch above him with the tablet propped against her knees. The greenhouse cameras filled one half of the screen. The other half showed the crib instructions.
2.id: Sarah berbaring di sofa di atasnya dengan tablet disandarkan ke lututnya. Kamera rumah kaca memenuhi separuh layar. Separuh lainnya menampilkan petunjuk perakitan boks bayi.

4.en: Step four. Insert tab A into slot B. Define tab A.
4.id: Langkah empat. Masukkan tab A ke slot B. Tab A itu yang mana?

5.en: Jack took the screwdriver out of his mouth.

6.en: The one I'm holding with my teeth.

8.en: Then I've been doing step four wrong for ten minutes.
8.id: Berarti sudah sepuluh menit aku salah mengerjakan langkah empat.

9.en: Aiden's voice came on the channel, soft. He and Unit Four had been in the greenhouse since five, with the outside cameras up on Aiden's bench and the blackout blinds still down on the western glass.
9.id: Suara Aiden terdengar di kanal, pelan. Ia dan Unit Empat sudah berada di rumah kaca sejak pukul lima, dengan kamera-kamera luar terpampang di meja kerja Aiden dan tirai gelap masih diturunkan di kaca sisi barat.

10.en: Door thermometer says twelve degrees Celsius. It barely moved all night.
10.id: Termometer pintu menunjukkan dua belas derajat Celsius. Hampir tidak bergerak semalaman.

13.id: Gelap. Tidak ada satu bintang pun.

14.en: By half past six, Jack had both end panels on the crib and one rail, and the end of the western road was coming out of the dark on the tablet the way it had the morning before, the white maintenance cart, the last stretch of asphalt, the wall of stems behind it. But the light was wrong. It didn't grow from one side. It just seeped in from everywhere at once, dull and even, like a room lit through a sheet.
14.id: Menjelang pukul setengah tujuh, Jack sudah memasang kedua panel ujung boks bayi dan satu pagarnya, dan di tablet, ujung jalan barat mulai muncul dari kegelapan seperti pagi sebelumnya, kereta pemeliharaan putih itu, ruas aspal terakhir, dinding batang rumput di belakangnya. Tapi cahayanya salah. Cahaya itu tidak tumbuh dari satu sisi. Ia hanya merembes dari mana-mana sekaligus, suram dan rata, seperti ruangan yang diterangi lewat selembar kain.

15.en: The drops were there. There were fewer of them. The long rows of small beads along the edges of the blades, the ones that had looked like strings of glass yesterday, were thin and patchy. Only the leaf tips still carried their big heavy drops, the same as before.
15.id: Tetesan-tetesan itu ada. Jumlahnya lebih sedikit. Deretan panjang butiran kecil di sepanjang tepi helai-helai daun, yang kemarin tampak seperti untaian kaca, kini tipis dan jarang-jarang. Hanya ujung-ujung daun yang masih membawa tetesan besarnya yang berat, sama seperti sebelumnya.

16.en: Sarah leaned closer to the screen.

17.en: Aiden, there's less dew. And I can't tell where the sun's supposed to be.
17.id: Aiden, embunnya lebih sedikit. Dan aku tidak bisa tahu di mana seharusnya matahari.

18.en: There's less dew along the edges. On a clear night the ground gets cold, and the air drops its water on it. Clouds keep it warm, like a lid. The tips still drip. That's the plant's water. The plant doesn't care about clouds.
18.id: Embunnya lebih sedikit di sepanjang tepi. Kalau malamnya cerah, tanah jadi dingin, dan udara melepaskan airnya ke situ. Awan menjaganya tetap hangat, seperti tutup. Ujung-ujungnya masih menetes. Itu air tanamannya. Tanaman tidak peduli soal awan.

20.en: So the clear mornings are the wet ones.
20.id: Jadi pagi yang cerah itu pagi yang basah.

21.id: Pagi yang cerah dan dingin. Ya.

22.en: High in the stems, the silk retreat hung pale and still.
22.id: Tinggi di antara batang-batang rumput, tempat persembunyian dari sutra itu menggantung pucat dan diam.

23.en: Six forty came. Then six forty-two.
23.id: Pukul enam empat puluh tiba. Lalu enam empat puluh dua.

24.en: Nothing touched the grass. No gold, no light catching in the drops. The gray just went on being gray.
24.id: Tak ada yang menyentuh rumput. Tak ada emas, tak ada cahaya yang tertangkap di tetesan. Kelabu itu terus saja kelabu.

25.en: Lena read it out the way she read everything.
25.id: Lena membacakannya dengan cara ia membacakan segalanya.

26.id: Enam empat puluh dua. Tidak ada matahari.

29.en: Jack turned a bolt with his good hand, slowly, and didn't take his eyes off the tablet. Six forty-five. Six forty-eight. The retreat didn't move.
29.id: Jack memutar baut dengan tangannya yang sehat, pelan-pelan, dan tak melepaskan pandangan dari tablet. Enam empat puluh lima. Enam empat puluh delapan. Tempat persembunyian itu tidak bergerak.

30.en: Sarah wrote something in her notebook and underlined it.
30.id: Sarah menulis sesuatu di buku catatannya dan menggarisbawahinya.

31.en: If it waits for the sun, it could wait all day.
31.id: Kalau dia menunggu matahari, dia bisa menunggu seharian.

34.en: At six fifty-three, the bag moved.
34.id: Pukul enam lima puluh tiga, kantong itu bergerak.

35.en: It wasn't the slow push of the other mornings, legs first, then the body, then a long pause. The spider came out of the silk in one smooth motion and was on the stem, and then it was going down the stem, and it didn't stop.
35.id: Bukan dorongan pelan seperti pagi-pagi sebelumnya, kaki dulu, lalu tubuh, lalu jeda panjang. Laba-laba itu keluar dari sutra dalam satu gerakan mulus dan sudah berada di batang, lalu menuruni batang itu, dan tidak berhenti.

36.en: Aiden's voice dropped to a whisper.

38.en: Jack had stopped with a crib rail in his hand.
38.id: Jack sudah berhenti dengan sebatang pagar boks bayi di tangannya.

39.en: The spider moved along the nearest blade in short bursts. Three steps, stop. Three steps, stop. It turned its whole front end in tiny jerks, left, right, down, the big front eyes staring over everything below it like a pair of searchlights. Two small dark feelers by its mouth flicked up and down as it went.
39.id: Laba-laba itu bergerak di sepanjang helai daun terdekat dalam sentakan-sentakan pendek. Tiga langkah, berhenti. Tiga langkah, berhenti. Ia memutar seluruh bagian depan tubuhnya dalam sentakan-sentakan kecil, kiri, kanan, bawah, mata depannya yang besar menyapu segala sesuatu di bawahnya seperti sepasang lampu sorot. Dua peraba kecil yang gelap di dekat mulutnya berkedut naik turun sementara ia bergerak.

40.en: It reached a drop as big as a barrel and stopped. It lowered its face right into the water.
40.id: Ia sampai di setetes air sebesar tong dan berhenti. Ia menurunkan wajahnya tepat ke dalam air.

44.en: It's drinking. They drink from dew. I've watched the little ones do it on the seedlings.
44.id: Dia minum. Mereka minum dari embun. Aku pernah melihat yang kecil-kecil melakukannya di bibit.

45.en: The spider drank for a while. Then it lifted its face and moved on.
45.id: Laba-laba itu minum beberapa lama. Lalu ia mengangkat wajahnya dan bergerak lagi.

46.en: Two drops along, there was a gnat stuck in the water, small and dark, about the size of a cat. The spider passed right over it. It didn't stop or turn.
46.id: Dua tetes dari situ, ada seekor agas terjebak di dalam air, kecil dan gelap, kira-kira sebesar kucing. Laba-laba itu lewat tepat di atasnya. Ia tidak berhenti atau berbalik.

48.en: It's dead. Or it's too cold to move. It doesn't see it.
48.id: Yang itu mati. Atau terlalu dingin untuk bergerak. Dia tidak melihatnya.

51.en: It doesn't see still things. Not really. It sees things that move.
51.id: Dia tidak melihat benda yang diam. Tidak benar-benar melihat. Dia melihat yang bergerak.

52.en: A little further down the blade there was another gnat, in a smaller drop. Jack saw it twitch. One wing, then a leg. Then it kicked against the water.
52.id: Sedikit lebih jauh di helai daun itu ada agas lain, di tetesan yang lebih kecil. Jack melihatnya berkedut. Satu sayap, lalu satu kaki. Lalu agas itu menendang air.

53.en: The spider swung its whole front toward it.
53.id: Laba-laba itu mengayunkan seluruh bagian depan tubuhnya ke arah agas itu.

54.en: It didn't jump this time. It crept, three steps, two, one, its body pressed low to the blade. Then it struck, so fast that Jack saw it only as a change, the spider in one place, then in another with the gnat held in front of it.
54.id: Kali ini ia tidak melompat. Ia mengendap, tiga langkah, dua, satu, tubuhnya merapat rendah ke helai daun. Lalu ia menyerang, begitu cepat sampai Jack hanya melihatnya sebagai perubahan, laba-laba itu di satu tempat, lalu di tempat lain dengan agas tergenggam di depannya.

55.en: The blade bent under the sudden weight. At its tip, the big drop shivered, slid, and came off.
55.id: Helai daun itu melengkung di bawah beban yang tiba-tiba. Di ujungnya, tetesan besar itu bergetar, bergeser, dan lepas.

56.en: It fell onto the empty end of the road and slumped into a low, trembling sheet, right over the spot where Aiden had crouched the morning before. It sat there, shivering, and then slid off the edge into the soil and was gone.
56.id: Tetesan itu jatuh ke ujung jalan yang kosong dan merosot menjadi lapisan rendah yang bergetar, tepat di atas tempat Aiden berjongkok pagi sebelumnya. Ia diam di sana, bergetar, lalu meluncur lewat tepian ke dalam tanah dan lenyap.

57.en: Nobody said anything for a moment.
57.id: Tak ada yang bicara selama beberapa saat.

58.en: Then Aiden spoke, slowly, as though he were working it out as he went.
58.id: Lalu Aiden berbicara, pelan, seolah ia sedang memecahkannya sambil bicara.

59.en: It's not hunting the road. It's hunting the drops. Everything that got stuck in them overnight starts kicking when it warms up. And it takes the ones that kick.
59.id: Dia tidak berburu di jalan. Dia berburu di tetesan. Semua yang terjebak di situ semalaman mulai menendang-nendang begitu badannya hangat. Dan dia mengambil yang menendang.

61.en: Six fifty-three, out. Six fifty-six, drinking. Seven oh one, the gnat. No basking.
61.id: Enam lima puluh tiga, keluar. Enam lima puluh enam, minum. Tujuh lewat satu, si agas. Tidak berjemur.

62.en: The spider climbed back up the stem with the gnat and stopped at the edge of the light, eating. Below it, in the gray, more insects were arriving. Jack could see them coming in out of the grass, flies mostly, heavy and slow, settling on the tips of the leaves where the big drops had been.
62.id: Laba-laba itu memanjat kembali batang rumput dengan agasnya dan berhenti di tepi cahaya, makan. Di bawahnya, dalam kelabu, makin banyak serangga berdatangan. Jack bisa melihat mereka muncul dari rerumputan, kebanyakan lalat, berat dan lamban, hinggap di ujung-ujung daun tempat tetesan-tetesan besar tadi berada.

64.en: The plant's water has sugar in it. It dries sticky on the tips. They come for that.
64.id: Air tanaman itu mengandung gula. Kalau kering, jadi lengket di ujung daun. Mereka datang untuk itu.

66.en: So the drops feed the flies, and the flies feed the spider.
66.id: Jadi tetesan memberi makan lalat, dan lalat memberi makan laba-laba.

67.en: And the spider drinks the drops. Yes.

68.en: One of the flies didn't land on a leaf. It came buzzing low over the end of the road, as big as a dog, and settled heavily on the white side of the maintenance cart.
68.id: Salah satu lalat tidak hinggap di daun. Ia datang berdengung rendah di atas ujung jalan, sebesar anjing, dan mendarat dengan berat di sisi putih kereta pemeliharaan.

69.en: Unit Four's voice came on the channel at once, not waiting.
69.id: Suara Unit Empat langsung terdengar di kanal, tanpa menunggu.

71.en: The spider turned to face the cart.

72.en: It finished the gnat. Then it came down.
72.id: Ia menghabiskan agasnya. Lalu ia turun.

73.en: It came down the stem and onto the soil, and from the soil onto the asphalt. It crossed the end of the road in short, low bursts. Three steps. Stop. Three steps. Stop. The fly on the cart cleaned its face with its front legs.
73.id: Ia turun dari batang ke tanah, dan dari tanah ke aspal. Ia menyeberangi ujung jalan dalam sentakan-sentakan pendek dan rendah. Tiga langkah. Berhenti. Tiga langkah. Berhenti. Lalat di kereta itu membersihkan wajahnya dengan kaki depannya.

74.en: The spider was halfway across the road. Then it was beside the cart's rear wheel, pressed low.
74.id: Laba-laba itu sudah separuh jalan menyeberang. Lalu ia sudah di samping roda belakang kereta, merapat rendah.

76.en: The spider stood on the asphalt beside the cart for a long time, the fly held in front of it. It stood in the gray, in the open, right where the rope had run out to the hitch the morning before.
76.id: Laba-laba itu berdiri di aspal di samping kereta untuk waktu yang lama, lalat tergenggam di depannya. Ia berdiri dalam kelabu, di tempat terbuka, tepat di tempat tali terulur ke kait gandengan pagi sebelumnya.

77.en: Unit Four's voice was very quiet.

79.en: Mark didn't say anything about that.

82.en: This time he didn't say sir.
82.id: Kali ini ia tidak menambahkan Pak.

83.en: The spider turned, walked back across the road at an unhurried pace, climbed the stem and went into the silk bag with its breakfast.
83.id: Laba-laba itu berbalik, berjalan kembali menyeberangi jalan dengan langkah tak tergesa, memanjat batang rumput dan masuk ke kantong sutra bersama sarapannya.

84.en: Jack realized he was still holding the crib rail. He set it down.
84.id: Jack sadar ia masih memegang pagar boks bayi itu. Ia meletakkannya.

85.en: Sarah had turned back through her notebook. Her pen moved down one page, then another.
85.id: Sarah sudah membalik-balik kembali buku catatannya. Pulpennya bergerak menuruni satu halaman, lalu halaman lain.

86.en: Aiden. The door thermometer. What did it say the last two mornings, when the sun came up?
86.id: Aiden. Termometer pintu. Berapa angkanya dua pagi terakhir, waktu matahari terbit?

88.en: Five. Then six. Yesterday it was six.

91.en: Thirteen degrees, when it came out.
91.id: Tiga belas derajat, waktu dia keluar.

92.en: Sarah sat up a little against the cushions, and Jack didn't stop her.
92.id: Sarah duduk sedikit lebih tegak bersandar pada bantal, dan Jack tidak mencegahnya.

93.en: Then that's it. On the cold mornings, the sun came up, and it came out, and it sat still in the sun first. On the seventh, it sat there a quarter of an hour. That wasn't patience. It was cold. It was warming up. Today there was nothing to warm up from. So there was no waiting.
93.id: Kalau begitu itu dia. Pada pagi-pagi yang dingin, matahari terbit, lalu dia keluar, dan dia diam dulu di bawah matahari. Tanggal tujuh, dia diam di sana seperempat jam. Itu bukan kesabaran. Dia kedinginan. Dia sedang menghangatkan badan. Hari ini tidak ada yang perlu dihangatkan. Jadi tidak ada penantian.

94.en: Aiden made the same sound he had made in the greenhouse that first morning, half a laugh and half a gasp.
94.id: Aiden mengeluarkan bunyi yang sama seperti di rumah kaca pada pagi pertama itu, setengah tawa dan setengah tersentak.

95.en: It's not the sun. The sun tells it when. The cold tells it how fast.
95.id: Bukan mataharinya. Matahari memberi tahu kapan. Dingin memberi tahu seberapa cepat.

96.en: Jack picked it up from there.

97.en: And the cold mornings are the wet mornings. Most water, slowest spider.
97.id: Dan pagi yang dingin itu pagi yang basah. Air paling banyak, laba-laba paling lamban.

98.en: Over the channel, from the station, he heard the squeak of a marker on the whiteboard. Mark read it out as he wrote.
98.id: Lewat kanal, dari stasiun, ia mendengar decit spidol di papan tulis. Mark membacakannya sambil menulis.

103.en: Covered. Paul's lid isn't optional. Anything that holds water out there has a lid on it. An open trough isn't a trough. It's just one more drop. A long one. Whatever falls into it and kicks is breakfast, and you saw where it goes for breakfast.
103.id: Tertutup. Tutup buatan Paul itu bukan pilihan tambahan. Apa pun yang menampung air di luar sana harus ditutup. Talang terbuka itu bukan talang. Itu cuma satu tetesan lagi. Yang panjang. Apa pun yang jatuh ke dalamnya lalu menendang-nendang jadi sarapan, dan kalian sudah lihat ke mana dia pergi untuk sarapan.

104.en: There was a long silence on the line. Then the marker squeaked again.
104.id: Sambungan itu hening lama. Lalu spidol berdecit lagi.

106.en: Lena. Get Paul on the radio. I want to see his trough.
106.id: Lena. Panggil Paul lewat radio. Aku mau lihat talangnya.
